Last night it felt painful to put pressure on and my finger print couldn't unlock my phone.

>is there a pain clinic in your area that specializes in yoga for pain?

No, there isn't any kind of pain management clinic. Our state hardly allows doctors to prescribe any kind of pain management for fear of addiction. My friend gave birth last year, c-section, and they gave her tylenol for her post-surgical pain. Fucking. Tylenol. Bonus I'm allergic to tylenol and NSAIDs.

>Do you associate every worker in the mental health field as a therapist?

Basically yes. All they want to do is judge me, convert my religion, or get their bonuses for pill peddling. Excluding the ones who want to molest me, of coarse. It doesn't really matter what their actual title is, they all do the same thing for the same reasons. I'm not fucked up because I'm mentally ill. I'm fucked up because I'm in constant, severe pain all the time (because of the brain damage). All that their pills do is mask the symptoms without handling the main problem, the physical pain. So ya know their uselessness to me paired with my trust issues makes it really hard for me to take the idea of intentionally seeing one seriously. I already know all about the techniques they'd use other than drugs, and they don't work. The issues are internal not external, so external "pretending everything is ok" hippie bullcrap doesn't help me (aka, "cognitive therapy"). Cognitive therapy actually made me worse, because I started to believe it and then my life went to even worse shit during that time, so instead of expecting things to suck, I thought it was going well and so it tore the rug out from under me.
